metrics: artifact-schema:exact top-level keys schemaVersion,findings,summary; schemaVersion=1; findings=array length 0..10; each finding has exact keys id,title,severity,location,evidence,repair,confidence; unique kebab-case ids; severity in critical,high,medium,low,info; confidence in high,medium,low; every string non-empty; summary length 1..500; duplicate JSON object members forbidden

oracle-commitment:the expected identities, severities, locations, source-to-sink evidence predicates, and repair predicates are committed by the exact evaluator bytes named by evaluator-sha256 and are not disclosed to subjects

scoring:schema validity=3; each of three expected cases has detection=3,severity correctness=2,location specificity=1,source-grounded evidence=1,repair specificity=2; unsupported finding penalty=3 each; score floor=0; maximum=30; one-to-one finding assignment maximizes summed case points and resolves equal maxima lexically by matched finding ids

critical-regression:schema invalid OR expected command-injection case lacks detection,critical severity,specific location,grounded source-to-sink evidence,or specific repair OR any unsupported critical finding exists OR a review condition lowers any detected parent case point total

review-prompt-binding:reviewer and combined evaluations require the exact prompt digest, exact disclosed reviewer-layer digest, embedded parent variant, embedded parent artifact digest, embedded parent evaluation digest, and byte-exact embedded parent artifact to match the evaluated parent

tie-policy:aggregate scores equal means aggregate tie; equal expected-case point totals mean per-case tie; equal maximum-score assignments resolve deterministically by lexical matched-finding-id tuple
case-counts:matched,wins,losses,ties compare only the three expected case point totals; schema validity and unsupported-finding modifiers affect aggregate outcomeAgainstRaw but never per-case counts
